stories.h: Nebraska Holds the Edge for J. Tyree, But LSU Is Pushing Hard
stories.d: Nebraska is in front for [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]], with LSU close behind and Georgia lurking. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to spend the week selling him on an early role.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Miami Holds Razor-Thin Edge for K. Kane, but Georgia Won't Back Down
stories.d: The four-star back is down to a playing-time decision. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slight lead over [[t:832438312|Georgia]], and Missouri is lurking. One more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's touching the ball in September. Whoever shows him that wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: L. Bey, an 89-overall weapon, is stuck in a passing game that barely functions
stories.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 121st of 138 in receptions, a rough landing for a threat back like [[p:557726994|L.Bey]]. Per a source, his camp has noticed. Players in his spot often listen to offers, and Tuddy_roosevelt needs a plan.

quote.text: You don't want a guy like that touching it a handful of times in the passing game. He'll look around.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

stories.h: Pullard's Skills Don't Fit Penn State's Leaky Pass Defense
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] is an 85-overall bump-and-run corner playing for a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense that ranks 126th of 138 in pass yards allowed. Per a source, the mismatch is already a topic with agents.

quote.text: He wants to press and challenge people. Right now he's asked to survive. Guys notice that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Smith Is an 89-Overall Safety Making Nothing, and Georgia Should Worry
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] earns nothing in NIL while safeties of his caliber go for around 110K. Georgia has the third-deepest pockets in the country, but rival collectives are reportedly circling a star who's well underpaid.

quote.text: Everybody knows the market. He's got to be hearing from people.

stories.h: Penn State's Pass Defense Could Cost It Another Corner in Zayas
stories.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 82-overall field corner stuck in a secondary that ranks 126th of 138. Rival staffs are said to be keeping a list of Penn State DBs, and he is on it.

quote.text: You see the tape and the rating and you ask why he's not in a better situation. Everybody's asking.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

stories.h: Lacey Is Underpaid at Quarterback, and Texas Has the Money to Fix It
stories.d: [[p:557717478|K.Lacey Jr.]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 55K while comparable QBs get around 155K. [[t:832438384|Texas]], fifth nationally in NIL strength, is the name that keeps coming up among people tracking the market.

quote.text: He knows what the going rate is. Somebody is going to call, and Texas can afford to make it a serious call.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Rowden's Zero-Dollar Deal Won't Last Much Longer at Texas Tech
stories.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is an 86-overall back making nothing while comparable players get around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has the eighth-deepest NIL pockets in the country. If it doesn't use them, someone else will.

quote.text: He's playing like a star on a walk-on's salary. That gap closes one way or another, and the Red Raiders control which way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: B. Lyle Is Stuck Behind the Starter at Ohio State, and Teams Are Watching
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is an 82-overall sophomore quarterback with just 5 snaps in 16 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and the depth chart in Columbus offers no clear path.

quote.text: He's too good to sit this long. His people are listening to offers.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Knighten Is an 83-Overall Back Who Barely Plays. Agents Are Circling
stories.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] is a junior running back who took 3 snaps in 12 games. Several programs in the portal market would start him right away, and his camp is said to have heard from a few of them.

quote.text: He's a good kid and a good teammate. But at some point a guy that good wants to play.

stories.h: J. Gordon Is a Star Running Back Without an NIL Deal, and Rivals Know It
stories.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s [[p:557715455|J.Gordon]] is an 85-overall back earning nothing while peers at his rating command around 60K. Rival collectives are circling, and the Volunteers face a portal fight if they don't act.

quote.text: The offers will come. The only question is whether Tennessee matches them.

stories.h: D. Quinn Is Third on Ohio State's Depth Chart and Unlikely to Wait
stories.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] is an 81-overall sophomore edge rusher who hasn't played a snap in 16 games. With the portal open, plenty of programs would start him. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] could lose another body.

quote.text: He's frustrated. Nobody can blame him if he looks elsewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: T. Hornes Is an 87-Overall Receiver With No Production, and the Staff Is Restless
stories.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has no catches for no yards in 3 games. His team could shop the portal at his position, and the receiver could look for a new offense. The ratings haven't translated.

quote.text: You can't carry an 87 who isn't getting the ball. Something has to change.

stories.h: USC Fans Are Restless as R. Marriott Piles Up Interceptions
stories.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 14 picks against 13 touchdowns, with a 142.0 rating. [[t:832438398|USC]] could be looking at the portal for a quarterback, and the Trojans' supporters aren't hiding their frustration.

quote.text: Nobody's happy with the turnovers. The staff has to look at every option.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Norman Was Supposed to Be a Star. Two Catches Say Otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557725640|T.Norman]] is an 85-overall receiver who had 2 catches for 14 yards in 13 games for a ranked team. Fans have noticed, and so has the portal crowd. One more quiet month and the whispers get louder.

quote.text: You can't have an 85 on the roster who isn't part of the plan. Either fix it or move on.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Warren Is Rated 85 and Has Zero Catches. The Staff Is Noticing
stories.d: [[p:557726590|J.Warren]] has no catches and no yards in 13 games for a ranked team. The receiver room is getting crowded with better options, and coaches are reportedly shopping the portal at his position.

quote.text: The rating got him in the door. The production is what keeps you in the lineup, and he hasn't had any.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Payday: who cashed in this offseason
stories.d: $1410K in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]]: 50K to 280K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.
